metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · The Last House
metas.description: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

metas.name: ★ 4.8 · 2026 · Scary Movie
metas.description: Two friends find themselves caught up in mayhem involving killers, monsters and supernatural creatures once again.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Backrooms
metas.description: After a therapist's patient disappears into a dimension beyond reality, she must venture into the unknown to save him.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Hokum
metas.description: A horror writer visits an Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, unaware the property is said to be haunted by a witch.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Lee Cronin's The Mummy
metas.description: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.

metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 2026 · Thrash
metas.description: When a Category 5 hurricane decimates a coastal town, the storm surge brings devastation, chaos and something far more frightening: hungry sharks.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · They Will Kill You
metas.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
metas.description: Grace MacCaullay battles old wounds with her estranged sister Faith MacCaullay while rival occult dynasties hunt them through a deadly contest that promises power, survival, and betrayal before dawn.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2026 · The Bride!
metas.description: In 1930s Chicago, Frankenstein asks Dr. Euphronius to help create a companion. They give life to a murdered woman as the Bride, sparking romance, police interest, and radical social change.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · Scream 7
metas.description: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · Cold Storage
metas.description: When a highly dangerous fungus escapes from a secret laboratory, a former bioterrorism agent is called back into action. Alongside two young employees, he must confront an invisible and out-of-control threat.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Send Help
metas.description: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Iron Lung
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic future after "The Quiet Rapture" event, a convict explores a blood ocean on a desolate moon using a submarine called the "Iron Lung" to search for missing stars/planets.

metas.name: ★ 4.0 · 2026 · Return to Silent Hill
metas.description: When a man receives a mysterious letter from his lost love, he is drawn to Silent Hill, a once familiar town now consumed by darkness.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.
